Name: Hellfire Blast
Text: Knockdown, HIT - You may remove the top 5 cards of your discard pile to discard a card in your rival's energy pile.

Name: Sweep Stop
Text: Choose 6 cards in your discard pile and put them in your energy pile.

Name: Inhuman Strength
Text: Flip when you play an attack that costs 1 or more.  That attack does +8 damage.  Remove this card. () Limit 1 per deck.

Name: Body Blow
Text: If your rival blocks any of your attacks this turn, Battle ends.  () HIT - Your rival skips his next action this turn.

Name: Demon Shout
Text: HIT - Your rival discards the top X cards of his deck.  X = the number of projectiles in your energy pile to a max of 10.
